_comment: COPY this file to directory.json and fill in your real members. directory.json is gitignored on purpose: it holds real school email addresses and names, which must not be committed to a public repo. The server reads directory.json (never this example) on startup. Each key is the member's Tsinglan email in lowercase; 'preferred' is the name they like to be called (leave "" to fall back to the full name); 'grade' is free text and only used to tell current members from graduated ones. See server/README.md, 'The member directory'.
